reproduction.rationale: The exact install command npx install-electron is given with Electron 42.0.1, Node 26.1.0 and Debian. Unlike an isolated app API call, installation itself is the entire operation, so treating these terminal instructions as a sufficient reproduction is plausible. The frozen rubric also literally asks bug reports lacking a gist or runnable app for a sample; a paired need-repro request is therefore accepted without being mandatory. The extract-zip issue URL is not a runnable repository.
